symbol.description: Vietnamese listed equity ticker, e.g. HPG.

days.description: Requested number of candles, not calendar days; default 365. Positive integer. Provider does not enforce the old prose claim of a 365 maximum. Replay accepts only explicitly recorded requests/default-equivalent arguments.

summary.description: True returns count/last/high/low summary rather than candle rows. False preserves rows; summary changes output shape.

columns.description: Optional array of raw candle keys: t date, o open, h high, l low, c close, v volume. Use ["c","t"], never "close" or ["close"]. Null keeps all fields. Production currently drops unknown keys silently; this C1 contract rejects them before that loss.

interval.description: Candle frequency: 1D daily, 1W weekly, 1M monthly. The provider canonicalizes case. day/daily are not accepted.

query.description: Asset ticker or human-readable asset name to resolve. May be ambiguous; inspect candidates and asset class before selecting the next tool.

symbol.description: Vietnamese listed equity ticker.

period.description: Statement frequency: quarter or year. quarter means quarterly reports; year means annual reports. quarterly/yearly are not supported values and must not silently select annual data.

statement.description: Requested statement section: all, KQKD (income), CDKT (balance), CSTC (ratios), or exact source statement label. Inspect returned section and warnings; unknown names may return all sections in production.

periods_n.description: Number of most recent periods to display, default 15. Read each value under its explicit period label and row unit; as_of is fetch time, not fiscal period.

category_id.description: Optional Vietstock indicator category ID; obtain IDs from source metadata, do not invent mappings.

term_type_id.description: Vietstock term-type ID (integer or string), default 3. Retains source ID semantics; do not infer monthly/yearly solely from a prose label.

sub_term_type_id.description: Optional source sub-term-type ID, integer/string or null.

from_date.description: Start date string in YYYY-MM-DD spelling, default 2022-01-01.

to_date.description: Optional end date string in YYYY-MM-DD spelling or null.

indicator.description: Optional source indicator filter such as CPI. Inspect series definition, unit and period; CPI may refer to different comparison bases.

tickers.description: Yahoo Finance tickers, e.g. GC=F (gold), CL=F (oil), BTC-USD. Null uses the provider commodity universe; do not use domestic equity symbols here.

period.description: Lookback using yfinance period spelling; default 2d. Not a financial statement quarter/year.

interval.description: yfinance bar interval, default lowercase 1d; spelling differs from vn_quote_history.

symbol.description: Crypto pair, default BTCUSDT.

count.description: Requested number of crypto bars, default 30; this tool has count, not days.

summary.description: True returns count/last/high/low summary rather than raw bars.

columns.description: Optional array of exact upstream crypto-bar field names; null keeps all. This endpoint does not promise quote_history short-key names.

symbols.description: Optional array of MSN currency/gold symbols such as USDVND and XAUUSD. Null defaults to those two. This is not a closed two-symbol enum; the provider may support other symbols. Do not replace with a string or invented Yahoo ticker mapping.

days.description: Calendar-day lookback for MSN history, default 35. Provider fetch span floors at five days and returns at most 35 series rows; this differs from vn_quote_history candle count.

symbol.description: Main Vietnamese equity ticker, compared with peers.

peers.description: Other equity tickers. Production uses at most the first five peers; excess peers are silently omitted. Supply at most five when complete coverage is required.

metrics.description: Optional list of source item_id strings. Aliases pe→p_e, pb→p_b, roe→roe, roa→roa, eps→trailing_eps, bvps→book_value_per_share_bvps are normalized by production. Other actual source item_ids are allowed; this is not a closed six-item enum. Missing/unknown metrics have warnings. Values belong to the latest annual period for each symbol, and PE/PB are period-end multiples, not current-price multiples.
